expected_issues.title: SSL context built for every forwarded request, including http URLs
expected_issues.description:
Every outbound worker-to-worker REST request now builds (and validates) a client SSL context from the worker config, even for plain http:// URLs, so workers with incomplete or unused SSL settings fail to forward requests.

Before the refactoring, SSL properties were only loaded when an HTTPS request required them. The new injectable RestClient creates the SslContextFactory unconditionally in httpClient(); misconfigured-but-unused keystores (common when listeners are HTTP only) now make request forwarding to the leader fail. The SSL context should only be created for https URLs.

annotator_notes: Upstream change https://github.com/apache/kafka/commit/fca5bfe13cb528b800ec48819c072b3130894009. Primary issue confirmed by the later upstream fix https://github.com/apache/kafka/commit/aea37adf3fe7965ff105c9a01969775db46603de; its regression test reproduces the problem on this head.
